resume: The essential procedures of the first weeks, to secure your rights and your children's arrangements.

elements.titre: Check my CAF situation (family benefits office)
elements.detail: Report the separation so that your rights are recalculated on your own income alone.
Caf, school, social security, tax office: who to inform and with which supporting documents.
Contact details, address and people authorized to pick up the child.
Third-party liability and personal accident cover up to date.

elements.titre: Check the top-up health insurance (mutuelle) covering the child

elements.detail: ID, health record, certificates: keep them in the vault.

elements.titre: Request a second family record book (livret de famille)

elements.detail: Health, school, hearings: note them in the calendar with a reminder.

elements.titre: Check which benefits I am entitled to
elements.detail: For example the allocation de soutien familial (family support allowance) if the other parent pays little or no child support.

elements.titre: If child support is not paid: the ARIPA (child support recovery agency)

elements.detail: A neutral third party to help you agree on the children's arrangements.

elements.titre: Check whether I am entitled to legal aid (aide juridictionnelle)
Apply to the family court judge (juge aux affaires familiales) if needed
Child's travel: authorization to leave the country

elements.detail: Judgments, agreements, letters: file them in the Court file folder of the vault.
